cases.safe_summary: A property-based test pattern could cover JSON normalization invariants.
cases.why_ai_coding_may_improve: Future agents tend to write example-only tests for parser boundaries.
cases.applicability_limits: Use only where the repo accepts property-test dependencies or already has Hypothesis.
cases.validation_or_eval_idea: Add one sanitized round-trip invariant test for the parser boundary.

cases.safe_summary: A byte-oriented parser boundary could become a fuzz target before shared validator adoption.
cases.why_ai_coding_may_improve: Fuzzing can find malformed-input failures ordinary examples miss.
cases.applicability_limits: Use only for small pure parser/chunker/scanner boundaries with sanitized fixtures.
cases.validation_or_eval_idea: Create a minimal fuzz/property case and keep generated corpora local.

cases.safe_summary: A runtime-cost trace operation could prove whether fixture setup or Python CPU work dominates a slow command.
cases.why_ai_coding_may_improve: Future agents often guess at performance causes instead of collecting local profiler evidence.
cases.applicability_limits: Use local commands and sanitized summaries only; do not mail raw traces or private arguments.
cases.validation_or_eval_idea: Run cProfile or pytest durations on the same workload and record top symbols plus before/after timing.

cases.safe_summary: A shared Rust CLI may need API compatibility and mutation-test scouting before DAD recommends it.
cases.why_ai_coding_may_improve: Future agents need executable proof that public outputs and tests are strong enough for cross-repo reuse.
cases.applicability_limits: Use only after crate license/provenance and local cost are reviewed; mutation outcomes are candidate evidence.
cases.validation_or_eval_idea: Run cargo semver-checks or cargo mutants on a small reviewed crate and record command, exit code, and limits.

cases.safe_summary: A future language candidate may help agents if its compiler, formatter, package tooling, and test runner create better proof surfaces.
cases.why_ai_coding_may_improve: Future agents need a proof-surface inventory before DAD makes a new language recommendable.
cases.applicability_limits: Keep as a candidate until official sources, local validation commands, avoid-when limits, and a failure example exist.
cases.validation_or_eval_idea: Create a proof-surface inventory with minimum commands, one negative example, and a small local harness route.

cases.safe_summary: A blog claims a broad Rust rewrite is faster.
cases.applicability_limits: No source screening, profile evidence, or parity map.
